# Week 1: Foundations

**Goal:** Read and write components, templates, bindings and built-in control flow in TypeScript.

About 8 hours. Do the steps in order; skip steps marked for the other track.

## 1. Set up: Set up your machine and run Karkhana

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Files: [`START-HERE.md`](../../START-HERE.md), [`README.md`](../../README.md)
- Look for: Node 22.12+, Angular CLI 22, VS Code with the Angular Language Service, the app running on localhost:4200, all tests green.
- Concepts: Tooling, CLI and conventions

## 2. Read: [TypeScript Handbook: everyday types, narrowing, classes, generics (skim what you know)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/intro.html)

- [ ] Done · Foundations only · about 120 min
- Concepts: TypeScript essentials

## 3. Read: [Learn Angular in your browser: the components, templates and control flow lessons](https://angular.dev/tutorials/learn-angular)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 120 min
- Concepts: Components, inputs, outputs, content projection, Templates and bindings

## 4. Read: [Angular Essentials: components, templates and control flow pages](https://angular.dev/essentials)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 40 min
- Concepts: Components, inputs, outputs, content projection, Templates and bindings

## 5. Watch: [Angular – The Complete Guide (Udemy): getting started and essentials sections](https://www.udemy.com/course/the-complete-guide-to-angular-2/)

- [ ] Done · Foundations only · about 150 min
- No course licence? Watch the matching topics on the official Angular YouTube channel instead.
- Concepts: Components, inputs, outputs, content projection, Templates and bindings

## 6. Explore in the app: Concepts Lab: Bindings

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 45 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/lab/bindings`
- Files: [`src/app/features/concepts-lab/bindings-demo.html`](../../src/app/features/concepts-lab/bindings-demo.html), [`src/app/features/concepts-lab/bindings-demo.ts`](../../src/app/features/concepts-lab/bindings-demo.ts)
- Look for: Every binding type in panel 1; $index/$first/$even in @for; @switch; @let; content projection into ui-card.
- Concepts: Templates and bindings, Built-in control flow (@if, @for, @switch, @let, @defer)

## 7. Study the code: The product card: a presentational component

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 40 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/products`
- Files: [`src/app/features/products/components/product-card.ts`](../../src/app/features/products/components/product-card.ts)
- Look for: input.required(), output(), @let, chained pipes, NgOptimizedImage, no injected services.
- Concepts: Components, inputs, outputs, content projection, Pipes

## 8. Exercise: Add a clear button to the search box that empties the search model and hides when the box is empty

- [ ] Done · Foundations only · about 120 min
- Files: [`src/app/features/products/components/product-filters.ts`](../../src/app/features/products/components/product-filters.ts)
- Concepts: Templates and bindings, Components, inputs, outputs, content projection

## 9. Exercise: Move the home concept list into a typed concepts.ts file and add a text filter with computed()

- [ ] Done · Accelerated only · about 120 min
- Files: [`src/app/features/home/home.ts`](../../src/app/features/home/home.ts), [`src/app/features/home/home.html`](../../src/app/features/home/home.html)
- Concepts: Signals: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource, Templates and bindings

## 10. Self-check: Self-check: answer without looking

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 15 min
  1. What is the difference between [value], [attr.aria-label] and [class.x]?
  2. Why does @for require track, and what makes a good track expression?
  3. When would you use @let instead of a component property?
